label: conj:qbeta-c-k-closed-forms
title: Closed-form conjectures for $c_4, c_5, c_6, c_7$ in the $\mathfrak{Q}_\beta$ precision ladder ($z = \sqrt{q}/(q+1)$ frame)
html:
Closed-form conjectures for the \mathfrak{Q}_\beta precision-ladder coefficients c_4, c_5, c_6, c_7.

In terms of the Hopf–Jones seed c_3 = -2 and the Kashiwara coupling b, the conjectured closed forms are

  c_4 = c_3\, b^4 = -2 b^4, \qquad
  c_5 = -\bigl(b^2 + \tfrac{1}{2}\bigr), \qquad
  c_6 = c_3^2\, b^2 = 4 b^2, \qquad
  c_7 = c_3^3 = -8.

Scope. The ladder these coefficients belong to is formulated at the auxiliary loop parameter z_{\mathrm{aux}} = \sqrt q/(q+1); at the canonical Markov parameter z = q^3/(q^2+1), no corresponding c_k ladder has been derived. The conjecture therefore applies to the z_{\mathrm{aux}} = \sqrt q/(q+1) expansion only.

The comparison of these forms with extracted values, the open derivation paths, and the precision record are in Open derivation paths, precision leverage, and SDP evidence for the c_k.
